python3 - <<'EOF'
import socket, struct
# Check listening TCP ports on localhost
try:
    data = open('/proc/net/tcp').read().splitlines()[1:]
    print("TCP listeners on localhost:")
    for line in data:
        parts = line.split()
        local = parts[1]
        st = parts[3]
        ip_hex, port_hex = local.split(':')
        port = int(port_hex, 16)
        if st == '0A':  # LISTEN
            ip = socket.inet_ntoa(struct.pack('<I', int(ip_hex, 16)))
            print(f"  {ip}:{port}")
except Exception as e:
    print("err", e)
EOF
